about: L4 prim-zoo fixture and goldens (the test strategy, sections 3.1 and 3.3). Rendered by the exported viewer's --test-render at 640x360 with Stage.ZooCamera, the fixed test environment and light, no MSAA/TAA/FXAA, from the core's world state through the presentation coordinator (RenderingServer). Tolerance: the terrain goldens' (fixtures/terrain/manifest.json). Goldens are proposed by the render script and approved by a person after viewing.

fixture.provenance: generated by Viewer.Shell.PrimZoo.Make() (deterministic; PrimWorldTests checks the file against it)
fixture.redistribution: generated in this repo; no third-party content
fixture.content: 22 prims: box, cylinder, prism, sphere, torus, tube, ring; cut+hollow box, circle-hole box, square-hole cylinder, twisted box, tapered cylinder, sheared prism, path-cut box, dimpled sphere, cut sphere, torus with revolutions and radius offset, skewed tapered tube, twisted ring; a 3-prim linkset (root rotated 45 degrees); per-face colours on the box, a semi-transparent sphere, a cylinder with one semi-transparent face
fixture.negative_control: --tr-alter=prim: the twisted box's twist 90 -> 45 degrees, delivered through the core; must fail the diff
